title_zh: 约定分开展示残片与推测复原图

scenario.label_zh: 区分文物残片保存与推测性复原展示
scenario.goal_zh: 区分原物保存与推测复原并约定给复原图加上明确标签

context_zh: 博物馆展览沟通练习。馆员 Lu 与文物保护人员 Bea 讨论一只残缺陶碗的展示，不提供文物修复操作指引。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Lu
sentences.text: Could we show a complete bowl beside these remains?

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: We can show a drawing, but a reconstruction of the missing sections would involve some guesswork.

sentences.speaker: Lu
sentences.text: I don't want visitors to confuse that with the original object.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Then keep preservation of the fragments separate from the illustration. We aren't proposing physical restoration of the bowl.

sentences.speaker: Lu
sentences.text: I'll place the drawing beside the case and label the missing sections as imagined.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Yes, and leave the actual fragments in their current display.

targets.sense_zh: 根据残存资料进行的复原
使受损物恢复原貌的修复
